eye.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This input is a CK3 eye diffuse UV texture atlas, NOT an illustration or icon. Preserve the exact centered iris placement, dimensions, sclera/veins surrounding it, seamless UV mapping and all existing details. Change ONLY the central gray iris and round pupil: make the iris a restrained amber-gold reptilian iris and the pupil a very narrow black vertical slit. Keep the iris circular at exactly the same radius and center as in the source. No glow, no eyelids, no added scales, no frame, no text, no 3D eyeball, no perspective. Preserve the flat square UV texture layout and opaque background. This texture must replace the original at the identical UV coordinates.
